QUOTE: Define only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, then call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)` before any allocation. This function exists only in this mode. In macro mode it is not declared and not compiled, so calling it fails to link.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in macro mode the function is neither declared nor compiled, rather than present and ignored.
